title: Stellar Lumens XLM Price Analysis - Pulling back after a rejection at resistance
description:

#stellarlumens        #stellarxlm       #xlmanalysis

So we had like maybe two months of just retesting the former resistance level of this falling wedge. It held up as a support. It looked like we were going to get a strong break to the upside. Bye.
